title: What are Projects?

body.text: Projects is a Claude.ai feature that lets you create a dedicated 'workspace' for each kind of work. What makes Projects different from a normal conversation is that
Claude remembers context and information across conversations
within the same Project. No matter how many new chats you start, Claude always remembers the
base information, rules, and context you've set

example: "I want to create a Project for writing a technology blog. What should I set up in the Project to start?"

title: Why are Projects useful?

body.text: Before Projects, you had to explain the context every time you started a new chat. Projects fix this by letting you
set a system prompt, or base instructions
that Claude remembers throughout the Project — your writing style, company info, or work rules — so you don't have to retype it. And Claude
stays consistent across the whole Project

example: "In this Project, always answer in Thai, use polite language, and focus on content for office workers aged 25–35."
